title: Feature-flag store with atomic JSON persistence and corrupt-file failure
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag the read-modify-write in set() as racy for concurrent writers, or mkstemp files as a leak. The stated contract only promises readers never see a torn file, which os.replace after fsync guarantees, and the temp file is unlinked on failure and consumed by the rename on success, as the check verifies.
